items.prompt: Why is calling 1.125 a binary-representation failure the wrong explanation for the half-up/ties-even difference?

options.text: Every decimal fraction is exactly binary-representable.
options.why: Many decimal fractions are not exact binary fractions. This particular one is.

options.text: The public function stores all means as binary float.
options.why: The shown window function retains an integer sum and does not convert its means to float.

options.text: There is no rounding policy difference at exact ties.
options.why: Half-up and ties-even can choose different neighbors at an exact tie.
The denominator 8 is a power of two. Different tie rules can disagree even when the value is represented exactly.
